abilities.text: At the start of your Command phase, this model regains 1 lost wound.

abilities.name: Evade and Survive
abilities.text: Once per turn, when an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move within 9" of this model, if this model is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can make a Normal move.

abilities.name: Turbo-boost
abilities.text: Each time this unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in this unit.

abilities.name: Merciless Judgement
abilities.text: Each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack that targets a unit that is Below Half-strength, add 1 to the Wound roll.

abilities.name: Shieldbreaker
abilities.text: Once per battle, when selecting targets for this model’s exitus rifle, it can fire a shieldbreaker round. If it does, until the end of the phase, each time this model makes an attack with that weapon, add 1 to the Wound roll and any successful Wound roll scores a Critical Wound.

abilities.name: Dead-shot
abilities.text:
When this unit is **selected to shoot**, until this unit has shot: 
- Enemy units do not have Lone Operative. 
- Hidden enemy units have +15" detection range.'

abilities.name: Shadow Assignment
abilities.text: This model cannot be selected as your WARLORD. If your army faction is AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM, then during the Declare Battle Formations step, you can replace this model with a different OFFICIO ASSASSINORUM model, provided that the points value of the new model does not exceed the points value of the model it replaced. Your army cannot include duplicates of the same model (i.e. after replacing this model with this rule, your army cannot have more than 1 VINDICARE ASSASSIN, it cannot have more than 1 CULEXUS ASSASSIN, it cannot have more than 1 EVERSOR ASSASSIN and it cannot have more than 1 CALLIDUS ASSASSIN).

abilities.name: Masters of Close Confines
abilities.text: Each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack that targets the closest eligible target, that attack has the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

abilities.name: Navy Bodyguards
abilities.text: If your Army Faction is not AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM, then for each VOIDFARERS CHARACTER unit you include in your army, you can include one VOIDSMEN-AT-ARMS unit in your army that does not count towards the number of RETINUE units your army can include.

abilities.name: Tactical Instinct
abilities.text: While this model is leading a unit, weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

abilities.name: Unstoppable Champion
abilities.text: The first time this model is destroyed, roll one D6 at the end of the phase. On a 2+, set this model back up on the battlefield, as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, with 1 wound remaining.

abilities.name: Leader
abilities.text: This model can be attached to the following units: AQUILA KILL TEAM, DEATHWATCH KILL TEAM

abilities.name: Strategic Knowledge
abilities.text: While this model is leading a unit, that unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.

abilities.name: Rites of Battle
abilities.text: Once per battle round, one unit from your army with this ability can use it when its unit is targeted with a Stratagem. If it does, reduce the CP cost of that use of that Stratagem by 1CP.
